buyers.minimum: No minimum stated on the sell page. 100-count and 1,000-count bulk lots are separate cart lines (1,000-count lots are the main bulk unit).
buyers.shipping: Seller pays. Trackable/insured recommended; CSI not responsible for loss/damage in transit. Ship to CoolStuffInc.com, c/o BUYER - SellOrderID#, 8550 S. US Hwy 17-92, Maitland, FL 32751. Must be mailed within 10 days of the approval email or prices may change.
buyers.condition_rules: Bulk: 'Please do not send bulk in played condition or in non-English languages.' Bulk Yu-Gi-Oh holos: near mint only. Singles in lower condition get up to 75% of NM price.
buyers.sorting_rules: Bulk is submitted as quantities of the 'Bulk' set lines (e.g. 1000 Bulk Commons/Uncommons, Bulk Rare, Bulk Super Rare). Rarities have to be separated to match the cart. CSI reserves the right to adjust quantities 'for any reason. This extends to bulk items as well.' One Piece 1000 C/U excludes DON!. MTG excludes Unstable/Unhinged bulk and basic lands (except listed full-art lands).
buyers.excluded: Played-condition and non-English bulk; MTG Unstable/Unhinged/Unfinity/Unglued bulk; artist-signed cards treated as played. Yu-Gi-Oh: only 'Bulk Holos' ($0.01) is listed, no flat common/rare line. buyers.turnaround: Cards are graded on arrival; account page shows status. Rejected items returned with a future order free, or separately for $2.99 (contiguous US card games); items not claimed within 2 months are discarded. Exact payout timing not stated on the sell page.
buyers.process: Online Sell List cart: add 'Bulk' lines per game, submit for approval, wait for approval email, then mail and report shipment date. Large collections (~100,000+ cards) go to buyer@coolstuffinc.com instead.
buyers.rates_last_updated: No date on page; rates read live from the sell-list JSON (action=getCards) on 2026-10-20.

buyers.name: Star City Games (Sell Your Cards)
buyers.store_credit_bonus: Singles get a store-credit bonus, but 'Sealed products and bulk items sold for store credit do not receive a trade-in bonus.' Bulk pays the same in credit as cash.
buyers.minimum: Check payouts need a Sell List Request of at least $10 (US/Canada). No other minimum stated; packages max 50 lb.
buyers.shipping: Seller pays all shipping/customs. Ship only after the approval email (Sell List Request: approval within 2 business days; Ship + Sell form: confirmation email is the approval). Sell List prices lock only if postmarked within 2 business days of approval; Ship + Sell has no deadline (arrival-day prices). Address: Star City Games, 5728 Williamson Rd NW, Roanoke, VA 24012.
buyers.condition_rules: Bulk cards in Heavily Played are not purchased; no non-English bulk. Four-tier grading scale; lower condition lowers the price.
buyers.sorting_rules: Remove all cards from binders, top-loaders and sleeves; keep every card facing the same way; for Sell List Requests, pack in the order shown on the request. Violations can cost up to 5% off the total or a declined sale. Bulk Commons/Uncommons must be a good mix of both rarities; bulk basic lands must be a mix of land types.
buyers.excluded: Bulk: non-English, heavily played, Time Spiral Timeshifted, MTG tokens (page says no bulk tokens, but a Magic Tokens line is priced $0.001), large quantities of specific cards. Flesh and Blood: the common/rare/super rare/token bulk lines (price $0.0005) and legendary/fabled/marvel/promo/gold lines are switched off (is_buying=false) as of 2026-10-20, so FaB bulk is limited to Majestic and foil lines. Lorcana: Enchanted, Inkwashed foil and non-foil Promo lines are off. No Yu-Gi-Oh, One Piece, SWU, Digimon, DBS, Weiss or sports.
buyers.turnaround: Sell List Requests take 5-7 business days after the 'received' email. Ship + Sell: offer by email within 5 business days (longer over 1,000 cards). PayPal paid within 2 business days of acceptance; checks printed within 2 business days.
buyers.process: Sell List Request (itemized cart incl. 'Bulk' menu; an SCG account is required to submit) or the Ship + Sell form (no itemizing). Approval email first, then mail.

buyers.name: Knight & Day Games
buyers.store_credit_bonus: Store credit rates are ~25% above cash on the unsorted lines ($8 cash vs $10 credit; Pokemon S&V $8 vs $12). Most sorted lines are store-credit only.
buyers.minimum: No minimum stated, but sports and 'other TCG' bulk need prior approval and have strict quantity limits.
buyers.shipping: The bulk page only describes in-person drop-off during store hours (6521 Las Vegas Blvd South, Ste C-105, Las Vegas, NV). Mail-in is offered for the singles buylist (cash paid by Zelle only, wait for approval email) but the bulk page does not offer mail-in; ask support@knightanddaygames.com before shipping bulk.
buyers.condition_rules: Lightly Played minimum; English only; no smoke-smelling cards; no signed, fake, heavily played or damaged cards.
buyers.sorting_rules: Cards must be in white BCW card boxes or empty ETB boxes (boxes not returned), upright, same direction, not sleeved, not in binders. Bought by weight (about 4 lb per 1,000), box weight deducted. Failing the rules can trigger a 25% sorting fee or full rejection. Rejected cards are returned at the customer's expense or forfeited after 30 days.
buyers.excluded: Pokemon: basic energy, code cards, yellow-border (Sword & Shield and older), sleeved, damaged. MTG: tokens, tip/advertisement/punch-out cards, emblems, sleeved, sets older than 5 years for mythics. One Piece: only Blocks 2-4. Star Wars Unlimited bulk is PAUSED with no rate published. Sports: no junk wax, no picked-over lots.
buyers.turnaround: Local drop-offs may be processed on arrival if a TCG staff member is free, otherwise usually within about 24 hours (singles page).
buyers.process: Walk in with the bulk during store hours (Mon-Sat 9am-midnight, Sun 10am-8pm per the bulk page). No online submission for bulk.
buyers.rates_last_updated: No date on page. Page checked 2026-10-20. Several games marked PAUSED ('WE HAVE PLENTY!').
buyers.reputation: Las Vegas game store (Town Square). Publishes the widest list of games of any bulk page found, including sports at $5/1,000 credit.

MARKET SHAPE (what the sweep found):
- Real, multi-buyer bulk markets (flat per-1,000 or per-card posted rates): Disney Lorcana (CoolStuffInc $3/1,000 cash; Star City Games $5; Card Throne $5; Bearded Dragon $8 (in-store); Knight & Day $8 (in-store, sorted by color); Untapped $7; Cape Fear $10; Sell2BBNovelties $10) and One Piece (CoolStuffInc $3; Cape Fear $5; Bearded Dragon $5; Sell2BB $10; Knight & Day $10 credit, currently paused except Super Rares). Star Wars Unlimited has a small market (Untapped $4, Cape Fear $5; Knight & Day paused, Bearded Dragon refuses SWU bulk).
- Thin: Yu-Gi-Oh (only Card Throne $5/1,000 commons, Sell2BB $10-20/1,000 mint-only, Knight & Day $5 credit, in-person Amazing Discoveries $2 and TNLG $4, Kruk $3; CoolStuffInc pays only $0.01 per bulk holo; Untapped and Cape Fear list Yu-Gi-Oh bulk as not buying). Dragon Ball Super: Sell2BB only (C/U $0.03 each = $30/1,000 mint-only; Knight & Day and Otakumart paused/tentative). Digimon: no active flat rate (Knight & Day paused, Otakumart closed; Sell2BB buys sealed only).
- Almost none: Flesh and Blood (Star City Games takes only Majestic $0.05 and foil lines; its common/rare/super rare bulk lines are switched off; Knight & Day paused), Weiss Schwarz (no buyer found), Digimon.
- Sports: mostly per-5,000-count box pricing from a few dealers: Kruk Cards (MI) pays $10-$50 per 5,000 depending on sport; iBuy.cards (IN) $1.50-$17.50 per 5,000 but only by pickup (no mail-in; 20,000-100,000 card minimum screening); Knight & Day $5/1,000 store credit sorted by team with prior approval (in person); Sell2BB posts minimum per-card prices only for 1950s-1970s and 2020s+ cards and no guaranteed price for 1980s-2010s. 401 Games (Toronto) buys sports in person only. No mail-in buyer posting a flat per-1,000 for modern base cards was found.
